full_page.content:
c. 1946
The following is a faithful transcription of a typed note by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. (typed on the margin of a mimeographed copy - titled Very Serious Words, a message of our Lord to Padre Pio)
NOTE :
Does not the following, in face of the growing immorality and its fearfully threatening climax atheism, remind one of the awful con- ditions and predictions immediately preceding the great Deluge of Noe's time and again, several generations later, the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrha and their being swallowed up in the Dead Sea? See also on rear page a definition of atheism the climax of stupidity.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Notes of Fr. Solanus Casey were typed on back page - referred to above:
To every normally thinking mind, atheism, the very antithesis of noble, progressive science has always been recognized as, by its very nature, a blas- phemous suggestion of the devil. This, however, does not exactly cap such a monster as we shall show presently, God willing. If we first have an idea of the primary and immediate purpose of atheism together with an knowledge whence it comes, as above, it will not be difficult to appreciate something of its perversity.
The direct and immediate object of atheism, in the designs of Satan, is to weaken belief in the supernatural and to rob souls of their life-giving faith in Almighty God. In other words, Begotten in Hell's hatred of God and in its coniving envy of mankind, atheism, by boldly denying the very existence of God would nihilize the very idea of supernatural virtue; and thus bring man down, not only to the level of the brute-beast but unspeakably below such a level; because, whereas the brute-beast has never been endowed with the facul- ty of hoping of believing in anything, especially above the senses; while the very soul of happiness for the rational man, consists in confident hope of what faith assures him is coming to him.
Atheism, therefore, (as a suggestion) aims at the very sources of mans' happiness, temporal and eternal. Hence the definition:
Atheism, to every normally thinking mind, is by its very nature, a blas- phemous suggestion of the devil, and the "omega" (Climax), of intellectual and moral insanity; is at once the hopeless conclusion and the desperate refuge of shallow thinking, of degenerate minds and - lamentably - of damned fools; none their primary leader other than Lucifer himself, the reprobate prince of diabolical deceiver's and, by God' permission, chief dictator.
